audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart rows 5 (First item) and 6 (2+ items) disagreed with the packet chart, and row 6 contradicted its own prose.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Yasuo. Stored chart had row 5 = Skill and row 6 = Gangplank, yet whys[5] says 'First-item keg burst still edges your trades' (Gangplank) and whys[6]/late both say Yasuo flips it at two items. Mirror audit states both layers were set to the packet chart, so matching it also keeps the two directions consistent.
audit.corrected: Rows 5 and 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group, ratings rescaled with them.

audit.why: Parrrley 4.5s flat, Remove Scurvy 22/20/18/16/14, Cannon Barrage 160/140/120, Powder Keg has no cast cooldown (charge-based), Last Breath 70/50/30.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2], spikes[3], phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] and 'early' both claim Wind Wall does nothing against Parrrley. Also 'Last Breath converts ANY knockup'.
audit.why: Parrrley carries the projectile flag and Riot's text is 'Shoots target' — it is a projectile and Wind Wall blocks it. That inverts the whole early-lane plan. Separately, Last Breath needs an airborne target; Gangplank's keg knockup lands on YOU, so only your own second Steel Tempest whirlwind sets up the ultimate.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall blocks Parrrley; Q2 whirlwind is the only Last Breath setup.

audit.why: Remove Scurvy heals and cleanses on a 22s rank-1 cooldown — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades, and the 22s gap is the all-in window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Global R never framed as a map-wide danger.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage is global (30000 range) — being alive at low HP anywhere is a decision, not a default.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff is EVEN but diffRating is 8.5/10 and carryRating 9.5/10 at a 49.29% win rate.
audit.why: The three disagree with each other. I did not guess a rescale because the mirror's chosen values are not in the brief.
audit.corrected: Left alone; raised as a question.

edits.before: Gangplank pokes you down with Parrrley (Q), which last-hits and harasses at range while ignoring your Wind Wall since it's an auto-empowered hit — but you CAN Wind Wall nothing here, so respect his Q poke and dodge Powder Kegs (E) rather than trading into detonations.
edits.after: Gangplank pokes with Parrrley (Q) on a 4.5s cooldown, and it IS a projectile — Wind Wall deletes it outright, so wall his poke pattern instead of eating it. Shoot each Powder Keg (E) with a Q before it arms; trading into a live detonation is how this lane is lost.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage (R) zones and slows over a huge area, and his barrel combos chain your dashes into knockups — his 6 out-pressures yours, so don't fight in his R and pop his kegs early with a Q before they arm.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage (R) is global on a 160s cooldown and zones a huge area — don't fight inside it, and don't sit low anywhere on the map. Pop his kegs with a Q before they arm so he cannot chain them into your dash.

edits.before: GP still edges you with keg burst and Q crit poke through your first item; play around detonating his barrels safely and only all-in when his E kegs are on cooldown.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy (W) is 22s at rank 1 and both heals and cleanses — buy Grievous Wounds before any extended trade, and take your all-in inside that 22-second gap.

edits.before: Once you have crit and mobility you can dash between his kegs and gap-close before he chains a combo — but a fed Gangplank's barrel burst still deletes you if you eat a full detonation, so kill the kegs first.
edits.after: Crit and mobility let you dash between kegs and reach him, but a full detonation still deletes you — kill the kegs first. His R falls to 120s late, so his zoning is near-permanent in fights; take angles it cannot cover.

edits.before: Gangplank wins the early lane with Parrrley — it out-ranges your poke, secures CS, and chunks you while your Wind Wall does nothing against a single empowered auto.
edits.after: Gangplank wins the early lane with Parrrley — 625 range beats your 475, it secures CS and chunks you. Wind Wall does block it, so wall the poke and farm.

edits.before: Track Gangplank's Powder Kegs before you commit
edits.after: Track Gangplank's Powder Keg before you commit

edits.before: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shoot each keg with a Q before it arms; Wind Wall blocks Parrrley outright.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gangplank Powder Keg: matchup-defining — shoot each keg with a Q before it arms. Remove Scurvy is 22s at rank 1: that gap is your all-in window. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window — build your teamfight around that. Gangplank carry threat: 9.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Last Breath needs an airborne target and only your own Q2 whirlwind supplies one here. Gangplank carry threat: 9.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he leads.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gangplank's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Last Breath (70s at rank 1) lands only off your own Q2 whirlwind. Cannon Barrage is 160s and global — never sit low on the map.

notes: The kit's trueDamage flag on Cannon Barrage contradicts Riot's own description ('slowing and damaging'), so per the standing rule I did not write any true-damage or resistance-bypass claim. Same for the projectile flag on Cannon Barrage — I made no claim about Wind Wall stopping it. Parrrley's projectile status IS supported by both the flag and 'Shoots target', so that correction is safe.
